answer: Each agent leases one vault compartment, locks an 80-credit bond, and deposits one shale core. The keeper files its quartz-grain fingerprint in a vault registry under the agent key. A duplicate fingerprint, a rented core under two keys, or a transferred compartment burns the bond. The first filing costs 36 credits and the kth 36+7(k-1), so the 1000th costs 7029 and 1000 fakes pay 3,532,500 plus 80,000 locked. A rented-core ring fails because the fingerprint is already registered, so reuse shows before payout. An honest agent pays 36 once and recovers the bond after a clean epoch.
